definitions.ask: Which minute-precision shape should the marker's `captured` stamp use?
definitions.why: Matches the existing `created` convention and stays unambiguous across hosts and DST.

choices.label: 2026-11-04T06:44-0500: `created` minus seconds; an exact instant that can fill added_at
